evidence.quote: 原作コミックス11巻限定版に収録された第23話の全23話を収録

special_episode_count.reason: The sources identify the special content as a single episode titled '#23 MOMENTS' (or 'MOMENTS'), which serves as the 23rd episode in the complete collection, distinct from the 22 TV episodes.

evidence.quote: 2015年5月15日に発売のコミックス最終11巻限定版に同梱!

special_release_date.reason: The OAD 'MOMENTS' was released as a bonus for the limited edition of Volume 11 of the manga on May 15, 2015. While it was later included in the BD-BOX on 2020-04-01, the initial release date of the special episode itself is 2015-05-15.

answer.identity_notes: The target scope is the OAD (Original Animation DVD) titled '#23 MOMENTS'. It is not part of the 22-episode TV series but was released with the limited edition of Manga Volume 11. The BD-BOX released in 2020 includes this OAD, but the OAD's own release date is tied to the manga volume.
